performance_notes.signal: Domclick AI case is a clear outlier
performance_notes.evidence: ~88K Habr views, far above most audited Q3 engineering articles in this sample.
performance_notes.implication: AI alone is not the conclusion; the material combines a concrete experiment, strong first-person framing and an unusual scale claim.

performance_notes.evidence: YADRO superquiz reached ~11K views and was designed to collect answers in comments.
performance_notes.implication: Use comments carefully as a metric because the mechanic itself asks people to comment.

performance_notes.signal: 2GIS already has a competitive Habr proof point
performance_notes.evidence: The QA/geolocation field-testing case reached ~9.2K Habr views in the current snapshot.
performance_notes.implication: Geo/navigation + practical QA is a credible own territory, not a topic 2GIS needs to copy from competitors.

recommendations_2gis.action: Keep Habr as a core engineering channel and build from topics where 2GIS has distinctive proof.
recommendations_2gis.why: 2GIS already has a ~9.2K-view Q3 QA/geolocation case, while Habr is one of the easiest platforms for cross-company public comparison.

recommendations_2gis.action: Pilot a recurring video/audio tech series for 3 episodes rather than launching an endless podcast immediately.
recommendations_2gis.why: At least seven companies in the 25-company cohort have a confirmed podcast format, while a regular 2GIS tech podcast series was not found.

recommendations_2gis.action: Republish video to RuTube and, where relevant, audio platforms if the content is already produced.
recommendations_2gis.why: Competitors already use these channels; incremental distribution can be tested without creating a separate content machine.

recommendations_2gis.action: Prefer 2GIS-own topic territory: geo, navigation, location engineering, map performance, C++/graphics and practical QA.
recommendations_2gis.why: AI/ML and generic backend topics are crowded. Geo/navigation appears much less saturated in the current sample and is directly tied to 2GIS expertise.

recommendations_2gis.action: Try one low-cost interactive format: quiz, poll or challenge linked to a real engineering topic.
recommendations_2gis.why: YADRO and other companies show that participation mechanics can turn technical content into an interaction, but more comparable performance data is still needed.

recommendations_2gis.action: Do not choose a meetup topic only because many competitors use it.
recommendations_2gis.why: Java/JVM, Go and AI are visible across the market. A crowded topic needs a specific 2GIS angle to be worth adding.

methodology.performance_rule: Public metrics are snapshots. Views grow over time, so article age and platform must be considered. We do not add metrics across platforms as if they were unique reach.
methodology.comparison_rule: Use same-platform comparisons wherever possible. A higher view count does not prove that a format or topic caused the result.
methodology.absence_rule: Not found means not found in the public audit, not proof that the company does not use the format internally.
methodology.telegram_note: Public Telegram metrics can be collected from public posts and analytics services where accessible; full historical TGStat data may require API access.
